visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a black headscarf and a young man in a white thobe walk together in front of a massive white mosque with a tall minaret. The sky is a deep, clear blue. The woman points toward the camera with a bright smile, her hands adorned with rings and a small bracelet. The setting is bright with high-contrast natural sunlight. (2) The scene shifts to modern urban architecture featuring several geometric, high-rise skyscrapers with intricate facade patterns. The camera pans upward to emphasize the height of the glass and steel structures. Pedestrians in white robes walk on the sidewalk below, amidst green palm trees. (3) Transitions to a vibrant night scene in a public plaza. Numerous people, including families and children, are gathered on the green grass and stone pavement. Children are seen driving brightly lit blue and pink toy cars. The background features brightly lit commercial buildings and palm trees under a dark night sky. (4) Inside a clean, blue-tiled restroom. A woman’s hand points at a vanity with a white soap dispenser and a sink. The camera pans to show multiple closed stall doors, which appear identical to those in a female restroom. A man with a short beard and a grey t-shirt smiles and gestures towards the camera in a dimly lit hallway. (5) Close-up shots of car license plates and mobile phone screens. A finger points at numeric characters on a Toyota Camry license plate that are distinct from standard Western Arabic numerals. A mobile phone shows a wallpaper of a football player with time displayed in local numeric script. (6) A hand holds a smartphone showing a messaging app with text aligned from right to left. A finger scrolls through the chat, highlighting how the cursor moves in a non-Western direction. The background is a slightly blurred indoor setting. (7) Multiple women dressed in full black abayas and niqabs sit at a modern cafe table, waving at the camera. Only their eyes are visible. Then, two men in white thobes and red-and-white checkered shemaghs are seen operating an espresso machine in a sleek, industrial-style coffee shop. (8) A view from inside a car moving through heavy traffic at dusk. The dashboard and steering wheel are visible. The car pulls into a gas station where a digital display shows fuel prices and volume. A man’s hand is seen on the steering wheel while the car is being refueled. (9) The woman and man are seated on a green outdoor sofa at a rooftop cafe, holding coffee cups with latte art. They talk directly to the camera with cheerful expressions. The background shows an open-air terrace with a large speaker and other patrons. (10) High-energy footage from a crowded football stadium at night. Fans in green jerseys wave flags and cheer. The woman is seen wearing a green jersey, her face lit with excitement, looking up at the bright stadium lights and the massive green-clad crowd.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 台灣人去沙烏地阿拉伯最不習慣的. [Variety]: 8個文化衝擊!. (2) [Subtitle]: 1. 日夜顛倒王國. (3) [Subtitle]: 通常下午3點才會出門, 4點吃午餐, 晚上半夜12點才吃晚餐. (4) [Variety]: (12:40) 現在是半夜餒?!. [Subtitle]: 小孩們整個嗨翻, 商場都還沒關門超酷. (5) [Subtitle]: 2. 男生廁所裡「找不到小便斗」, 全部都像是女廁的隔間!. (6) [Subtitle]: 問了沙烏地朋友才知道, 他們都是坐著上廁所!. (7) [Subtitle]: 3. 文盲式旅遊. (8) [Subtitle]: 阿拉伯人是不用阿拉伯數字的!, 因為在沙烏地他們都是使用東阿拉伯數字!. (9) [Variety]: (圖片取自網路). [Subtitle]: 不管是手機、打字、車牌都是, 中間都要瘋狂拿小抄對照一下XD. (10) [Variety]: (貼在手機背面XD). [Subtitle]: 4. 打字的奇怪現象, 因為阿拉伯文打字都是從右到左. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以如果和英文一起打, 就會出現這樣的奇怪現象. (12) [Subtitle]: 5. 男女正裝差異. (13) [Variety]: (對宗教非常虔誠). [Subtitle]: 就算國家沒有規範她們, 但很多女生還是包的緊緊, 只露出雙眼. (14) [Subtitle]: 而阿拉伯的西裝就長醬!, 男生穿上白袍, 然後頭上戴紅巾. (15) [Subtitle]: 6. 超級少「電動車」, 是因為油比水便宜?!. (16) [Subtitle]: 當地最熱門的牌子竟然是Toyota跟福特. (17) [Variety]: (大家有覺得比較便宜嗎?). [Subtitle]: 究竟在產油大國加一次油要花多少錢呢?, 一公升大概20塊台幣!. (18) [Subtitle]: 7. 超·愛·喝·茶. (19) [Subtitle]: 一天準時跑3次咖啡廳, 早中晚各一次!. (20) [Subtitle]: 我以為台灣人絕對是最愛喝茶第一名. (21) [Subtitle]: 但這樣悠閒的步調, 我還真的是超級不習慣.... (22) [Subtitle]: 8. 足球的狂熱, 全國99%的人都瘋足球. (23) [Variety]: (給大家感受一下). [Subtitle]: 這個國家會長怎樣?. (24) [Variety]: (超帥!!!). (25) [Variety]: (全場暴動!). (26) [Variety]: (得分啦~~~~). (27) [Subtitle]: 以上8個! 那哪一項讓你最衝擊? (留言跟我們說!). (28) [Slogan]: 各國奇異文化觀察室. [Subtitle]: 下集待續! 記得追蹤喔.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, upbeat acoustic-pop BGM featuring a driving drum beat and bright guitar strumming. A female voice speaks with high enthusiasm and a rapid pace, setting an introductory tone. Digital UI 'click' sound effects punctuate the start of the narration. (2) As the topic shifts, the music maintains its tempo. The vocal delivery transitions between the female speaker and a male speaker, both maintaining a cheerful and informative tone. Subtle environmental hums of an indoor cafe are audible beneath the voices and BGM. (3) A distinct 'whoosh' transition effect occurs as the scene changes to the night plaza. Background crowd murmurs and faint laughter are heard, mixed with the ongoing BGM. The female voice raises her pitch slightly to express surprise when discussing the late-night activities. (4) During the restroom and number system segments, the audio features mechanical 'click' and 'tap' SFX synchronized with visual cues. The BGM volume ducks slightly to allow the explanatory narration to be clear. The acoustic texture remains bright and studio-processed. (5) In the stadium sequence, the audio profile changes dramatically. Loud, broadband crowd noise including synchronized cheering, chanting, and shouting surges in volume, momentarily competing with the BGM. The female speaker’s arousal level increases, matching the high energy of the crowd. (6) The video concludes with the BGM fading out. The speakers use a friendly, concluding tone with a final 'pop' sound effect as the 'to be continued' graphic appears. The overall mix is polished with high speech-to-music clarity despite the inclusion of environmental sounds.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Item 1 -> Item 2 -> Item 3 -> Item 4 -> Item 5 -> Item 6 -> Item 7 -> Item 8 -> Outro/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate and entertain viewers by sharing eight specific cultural 'shocks' experienced by a Taiwanese traveler in Saudi Arabia. It uses a high-energy, fast-paced listicle format to highlight surprising aspects of local life, such as social schedules, infrastructure, language, and sports passion, ultimately promoting curiosity and travel to the region.
